description: I want to create the possibility for the user to create insights generated by the Google Maps agent we have now deployed. Similar to the "generate gemini insights" button, there should be an option to generate agent insights. Initially the user will need to create a list of restaurants to provide, and after the user selects and filters those restaurants, it should be sent to the agent asking about the type of restaurant, the number of reviews and the average rating. This should be going to a new incremental BigQuery table that has the restaurant fhrsid, and the google maps agents insgiths.
